description: Send a message to Code-Fundi AI (Fundi chat: POST /v1/fundi/chat). Supports threading, optional code context, indexed repository knowledge (`knowledge_id`), embeddings memory, and voice mode. Responses are streamed by the API and returned as plain text (or JSON when the server uses JSON mode).

code_block.description: Optional code snippet combined with the question for code-aware answers

conversation.description: Conversation ID for threading (continues a previous conversation)

embed.description: Enable conversation memory via embeddings (default false)

knowledge_id.description: Repository / data-source UUIDs to pull indexed knowledge context into the chat (API field `knowledge`)

prompt.description: User message (sent to the API as `question`)

voice.description: Request voice/audio path on the server (default false)

name: code-fundi-chat
